newsitem.title: LEBANON: Zaire rebels release Lebanese nationals-Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels release Lebanese nationals-Beirut.

text.p: Zairean rebels released on Sunday 46 Lebanese nationals they were holding since March, Lebanon's Minister of Emigrants Talal Arslan said.
"The Lebanese residents held in Zaire were released today ...They will arrive in Johannesburg this evening," Arslan was quoted by the official National News Agency as saying.

Last week, Lebanese officials said that Lebanese embassies in South Africa and Zaire and some Lebanese residents in Zaire were handling a deal with the Zairean rebels to release 46 Lebanese nationals whom they held hostage last month.
Arslan did not elaborate on the nature of the deal that led to the release but Beirut newspapers have recently reported that the rebels were demanding a ransom of nearly $1 million.

There are 5,000 registered Lebanese nationals in the troubled Central African country where rebels seized the most important cities outside the capital as well as the richest mining provinces. Most of the Lebanese there are traders.
